[[Flame Ram Blueprint (blue)|Flame Ram Blueprints]] were originally used to construct [[flame ram]] build sites before the simplified system replaced them with the [[Flame Ram Blueprint]].

== Acquisition ==
* Chance from [[World versus World]] [[World Experience|rank rewards]]
* Small chance from [[Veteran Supervisor]] and [[Claim this land for your world|Sentries]].
